correctness.rationale: Exact projector reduction makes every leave-one-out contribution \(c[(k-1)+R_i]\). Conditional Gaussian orthogonal projection gives marginal chi-square with \(d=n-k+1\) degrees of freedom. Conditioning on the other k-2 columns reduces each pair to two independent isotropic Gaussian vectors in \(d+1\) dimensions. Their Beta angular fourth moment gives \(\operatorname{Cov}(R_i,R_j)=2d/(d+3)\), yielding exact variance and diagnostic formulas; k=1 and k=n+1 are separately checked. Rational identities, 528 direct Nyström computations and 750000 Gaussian samples corroborate but are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The sharp dimension/probe-count-dependent covariance gives a testable diagnostic-calibration factor for the raw exchangeable matrix-function trace estimator. The factor diverges near sample-rank saturation even while the true absolute variance remains positive and the empirical squared diagnostic vanishes in expectation. It is a motivated, exact all-dimension error-estimation boundary, with a precisely confined flat-spectrum scope and an explicit acknowledgement that prior residual normalization makes that particular model deterministic.
